visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An animated boy with a brown bowl cut and a single hair tuft sits at a table, holding a green smartphone. He looks bored and dismissive while staring at the device. The background is a clean white void. (2) A white, animated rabbit character with black inner ears and a skeptical expression appears behind the boy, leaning over his shoulder to look at the phone screen. (3) The rabbit character points its finger at the phone screen. The boy looks slightly startled and defensive, clutching the phone closer. (4) A bright red screen appears abruptly, featuring a white shopping cart icon with a speech bubble indicating '99+' items inside, suggesting a full cart. (5) A close-up shot focuses on the rabbit's face, showing its wide, judging eyes and a small smirk. (6) The screen shifts to show a mobile interface with a list of blurry shopping items and a distinct red 'Order Total' box showing the amount $216,706. (7) The boy is shown sweating and looking guilty, with large circular eyes, as the rabbit looms over him. (8) The video ends with a black screen and white text centered in the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice starts speaking with a weary sigh and a relaxed, conversational tone. Upbeat synth-pop music with a clear electronic beat begins in the background. (2) A second male voice interrupts with a sharp 'Hmm?' and a sliding pitch, followed immediately by a quick 'Whoosh' sound effect that signifies a comedic shift. (3) A series of 'Ding' sound effects and a rhythmic 'Whoosh' play as the conversation becomes more animated. The first voice becomes higher in pitch and faster as he gets defensive. (4) A dramatic, high-arousal comic impact SFX (like a orchestral hit or slide) plays as the shopping cart is revealed. (5) The second voice reads out the large number with a teasing, exaggerated tone. The background music continues steadily until a sudden hard cut at the very end of the dialogue.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic animated short that parodies consumer psychology during the 'Double 11' shopping festival. It highlights the irony of people claiming they have nothing to buy while secretly amassing a massive, unaffordable shopping cart. The fast-paced editing and exaggerated voice acting emphasize the relatability of the conflict between shopping desire and financial reality.
